title: LifeStraw Personal Water Filter — up to 4,000 L, No Chemicals
short_description: A compact personal water filter, filters up to 4,000 litres, removes 99.999999% of bacteria and 99.999% of protozoa. Only 57 g, no chemicals or batteries.
long_description: The LifeStraw Personal Water Filter makes contaminated water drinkable on the go. It filters up to 4,000 litres, removes at least 99.999999% of bacteria and 99.999% of protozoa, and works down to 0.2 microns — without iodine, chlorine or other chemicals. At only 57 g and 22.5 cm long it is ultralight, needs no batteries and has no moving parts. Ideal for hiking, camping, travel, backpacking and emergency preparedness.
buying_angle: Practical for hikers, campers and emergency preparedness — clean drinking water from almost any source, ultralight and chemical-free.
